title: Round 5, stream B: the Stålheart's pad under its rails, every printed structure as a wireframe first then its skin, DAY 42's reveal skipped by Escape only
context: The owner's notes of 2026-11-05 on 00163b90 (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-05-round-5-ten-notes-design.md, stream B): 2) the Stålheart's base is not under it, half the rails are off; 4) and 5) the radar prints as a wireframe first and the texture after, and anything printed does; 9) driving the tank must not skip DAY 42's party, only Esc skips.
decision: 2) The slab grows toward +X only: island stalheart x 0 -> 4.5, w 48 -> 57 (slab -24..+33), the structure's offset 14.5 -> 10, so island x + offset stays 14.5 and the model does not move; the bestiary's PLOT reads 57 x 56 m. 4+5) src/fx/structure-print.js: on a structure's first print tick (story-base grow, 0 < k < 1) the shown tier (the far tier when there is one) is cloned without its userData as a wire ghost in Isao's print-beam blue (KIT.print { colour 0xbfe6ff, opacity .85, skin .8 }, one shared material), a child of the holder; the solid tiers are hidden and the holder stands at full size; a plane climbs the tier's own height (printSpan) with k. At k = 1 the shown tier skins in over 0.8 s, driven by the base's tick so it finishes off screen, then the ghost goes and the LOD resumes. A structure set straight to 1 (a chapter skip, a grown base) has no ghost; k = 0 (the close-up's replay) starts over. tower-print.js generalised, sentries unchanged: cut() takes a span, printGhost a shared material, skinIn a driven mode and end(). Islands, walls and gates are instanced pieces shared by every island and keep their Y rise this round: 'anything printed' is read as the structures. The radar's close-up already holds 1.5 s past the print's end, longer than the 0.8 s skin, so no change to antenna-print's end rule. 9) camera-shot gains passKeys: a shot with a skipKey and passKeys lets every other key through to the game (taps still eaten); DAY_42.shot takes skipKey 'Escape', passKeys, the hint ESC · SKIP; td-tab's drive gate lets the hull move under discoReveal (same line, 0 net lines). The shot's capture listener takes Escape first, so it never reaches the tank's pause.
outcome: Commits on round-5-base: 03c19e8f (note 9), d9e5d72f (notes 4+5), 782f5d64 (note 2), 6282cfb7 (notes 4+5 fix: a mounted tier's userData holds its AnimationMixer, and Object3D.copy deep-copies userData through JSON, so the first clone threw in the game; --antenna-print found it). Measured: note 2, ground parts of the game and far GLBs (accessor bounds, y <= 1.5 m) x -3.39..+32.39 in the pad frame against a -24..+24 slab before (8.4 m of the +X rail off the pad, z inside), 0.61 m of slab past them after; story-lab frames from +X, -X, above and low before and after. Note 4+5: before, a Y scale of the solid from 2 % to 100 %; after, in --antenna-print, the radar's print reads ghost/no solid at k .25 and .66, skinning at 1, then the ghost gone and the solid standing. Note 9: before, a W keydown ended the reveal and was eaten (the base modules); after, in --day-42, W held 1.2 s leaves the cut running and moves the hull, the hint reads ESC · SKIP, Escape ends the cut and the game is not paused.
alternatives: Move the model back onto the pad's centre: it would move what frames it (the disco ball's hang, the close shots, Isao's print positions); growing the slab keeps everything where it stood.
A symmetric pad (w 66 at x 0): it would come within 4 m of the farm and add 21 m of empty slab on -X; the -X apron already has 20.8 m.
The structure's wire swapped onto the solid's own materials instead of a clone: the skin needs the wire and the solid drawn at once while the wire fades.
skinIn run off the ghost's draw, as the sentries do: a structure printed off screen would keep its clipped materials until looked at; the base's tick drives it.
Escape plus any driving key ends the reveal only after a lock: the owner asked for Escape alone; the drop's and the print close-ups' Space rule is unchanged.
evidence: npm test (318 programs), npm run check, npm run architecture green at each commit; new test/disco-reveal-keys.mjs, test/structure-print.mjs, test/stalheart-pad.mjs (red on fbe323c0: -3.39..32.39 on -24..24).

Browser on port 18182 under the lock, on git-archive snapshots of the commits: --day-42 PASS (03c19e8f's tree); --antenna-print FAIL on d9e5d72f (the clone threw, the radar solid through the replay), PASS on 6282cfb7 with the wire and skin checks; --story-world PASS; story-lab frames scratch pad-before-*.png / pad-after-*.png; --grow red at 'Isao said gunship_overhead' after grow-settled on the stream's tree and identically on fbe323c0 (base red, a different step from the assembly print timeout the spec names; grow-stalheart-rising passes with the wire).
Open: the story lab shows the planet's ground poking through the Stålheart slab near its tangent point (present on fbe323c0 too, moved 4.5 m with the island centre); not touched.
